title: Brazil
text:
Brazil is a big country. It is in South America. Brazil has many rivers and forests. The Amazon is a big river in Brazil.

Many people live in cities near the coast. The sea is warm and blue. There are also mountains in the south. Some people like to visit the beaches.

questions.text: Why do you think some people like to visit the beaches?
options: Because the sea is warm and pretty
Because the sea is cold and dark
Because there are no towns near them
Because there are no people there

questions.text: What kind of place is Brazil?
options: A place with a lot of nature

vocabulary.definition: a large area of land with its own government
a long line of water that flows to the sea
the land next to the sea

paragraph_translations: O Brasil é um país grande. Ele fica na América do Sul. O Brasil tem muitos rios e florestas. O Amazonas é um rio grande no Brasil.
Muitas pessoas vivem em cidades perto da costa. O mar é quente e azul. Há também montanhas no sul. Algumas pessoas gostam de visitar as praias.
